title: The Rocks That Walk the Desert When No One Watches
summary: A translation of the same day's science episode. On Racetrack Playa, a dry lakebed in Death Valley, rocks weighing hundreds of kilograms leave long trails across the flat mud even though no one has ever seen them move. The episode follows the competing explanations, from wind alone and slippery algae to Sharp and Carey's decades of tracking named stones. It ends with the Norris team catching the stones moving in December twenty thirteen: after a rare rain, panels of ice only a few millimeters thick broke up in the sun, and a light wind pushed them so they shoved the rocks a few meters per minute.
